download.title: Before you download: BAFU's Terms of Use
download.intro: This file is part of a patched copy of BAFU's life cycle inventories: Modified Data, not BAFU's original data. Download it only if you accept BAFU's Terms of Use, and with them these three conditions:
points: Credit the source: “Life Cycle Inventory database of the Swiss Federal Administration, BAFU:2026”.
Keep the label Modified Data and the record of modifications with the data.
Pass it on only under terms substantially equivalent to BAFU's, and never sell it.
download.more: BAFU's terms, and what they ask of a copy

home_title: BAFU/UVEK inventory database: community findings · Sentier
description: Users of the BAFU/UVEK life-cycle inventory database record measured findings here, repeat each other's measurements and report them to BAFU.

verified_build.downloads: We checked both downloads against the patched BAFU inventory. For every exchange, we checked the flow, amount, unit and whether it enters or leaves the process. Where the source identifies a supplier, we also checked that link.
verified_build.comparison: 75 impact results changed. All 75 were in datasets and impact categories that the patches and import fixes could affect. This check allows changes of any size in either direction.
